prerequisites: Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering and Electronics

learning_outcomes.text: Students will receive fundamentals of information transfer, signals classification and characteristic, including spectral representation.
They will get a deep insight in analogue and discrete modulation of a harmonic carrier and impulse modulations as well as in modulators and demodulators in use.

syllabus_topics: Classification of signals
Characteristics of signals (energy, power, mean value)
Autocorrelation/correlation function of signals
Unit step, Dirac function, triangular signal, rectangular signals, radio pulse (computation of characteristics)
Fourier series (direct and inverse FS, properties of FS, spectrum of periodic signals
Computation of FS for rectangular, radio pulse, triangular pulse, harmonic signal
Computation of spectrum at Matlab system (rectangular, radio pulse, triangular pulse, harmonic signal)
Fourier Transform (direct and inverse FT, properties of FT, spectrum of non-periodic signals)
Computation of FT for rectangular, radio pulse, triangular pulse, harmonic signal (1 period)
Computation of spectrum at Matlab system (rectangular, radio pulse, triangular pulse, harmonic signal)
Communication model, propagation theorem
Examples of propagation theorem
Losses (free space path, terrain loss, multipath fading)
Communication model, propagation theorem
Complex examples of propagation theorem II.
Lab I. Measurement of radiation diagram
AM, FM modulation
Principles of AM (modulation, demodulation), properties, examples
Principles of FM (modulation, demodulation), properties, examples
Lab II. AM
Lab III. FM
ASK, FSK modulation
Principles of ASK (modulation, demodulation), properties, examples
Principles of FSK (modulation, demodulation), properties, examples
LAB IV. ASK, FSK modulation
BPSK, FSK modulation
Principles of BPSK (modulation, demodulation), properties, examples
Principles of FSK (modulation, demodulation), properties, examples
LAB IV. BPSK, FSK modulation
